caption: A handful of seed is scattered across bare soil with a sweeping throw, and the seeds land spread over a wide patch.

sa.check: A handful of seed is thrown with a sweeping motion over bare soil.
The seeds land spread over a wide patch.
The throw is a sweep rather than a drop.
The throw comes first and the landing follows.

pc.expect: Seeds fan out through the air in an arc during the sweep.
pc.fail: They fly back at the thrower; or all go to a single spot; or hang in the air.

pc.expect: The seeds drop onto the soil and stay.
pc.fail: They hang; or rise; or bounce high.

pc.expect: Seeds are tiny separate grains that scatter, not a stream or a clump.
pc.fail: They fly as one lump; or as a rope; or as liquid.

pc.expect: Seeds move only from the throw, and once landed they stay.
pc.fail: They move before the throw; or hop after landing; or drift.

pc.expect: Seeds come only from the hand.
pc.fail: Seeds appear with no throw; or vanish in mid-air; or multiply.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The soil and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The soil changes colour; or the field rearranges; or the hand changes.

note: The hand is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
